statement: Cayman Exempted Limited Partnership Act (2025 Revision) section 9 requires a filed statement naming general partners and supporting incorporation/registration documents for corporate/partnership GPs; subsection 9(2) makes records and filed statements open to public inspection, and section 12 permits any person to require certified certificates or registered statements for a fee.

The exact outstanding Cayman proof is EP Third Moment International LP and Master Fund LP registration certificates plus original registered statements and subsequent GP/name changes. Those could resolve legal form and the GP corporate identifier if the required supporting corporate document is accessible; they would not automatically prove Bleich ultimate economic ownership.

The preserved official Cayman fee schedule quotes general search CI$30/US$36.59 and certification/copy CI$150/US$182.93. These are published individual service fees; no total order price is asserted and no service was purchased.
